7-Zip.basis: LGPL-2.1-or-later; BSD components and unRAR restrictions remain applicable. Standalone ZIP/7z benchmarking does not copy or recreate RAR code.
conditions: Use an unmodified official executable and its supplied notices.
Publish original measurements, not copied vendor charts or artwork.
Do not bundle comparator binaries with SuperZip.

Zstd.basis: BSD-3-Clause option in the upstream dual license; no endorsement rights are granted.
conditions: Use the official standalone CLI with its notices.
Do not imply upstream endorsement or redistribute the comparator binary.

Bandizip.basis: Controlling Korean EULA section 1(4) permits Standard Edition commercial use. No benchmark restriction was found in the reviewed EULA; this is a license-review conclusion, not an express vendor endorsement.
conditions: Verify Standard Edition without inspecting or publishing product keys.
Do not redistribute binaries, manuals, screenshots, or artwork without separately established permission.
Do not reverse engineer or modify the program.

Hyperfine.basis: MIT or Apache-2.0; select MIT for standalone timing-tool use.
conditions: Use the unmodified timing tool and retain its notices.
Do not redistribute its binary in the product package.

lzbench.basis: Harness GPL-2.0-or-GPL-3.0; selected LZ4 library BSD-2-Clause and Zstd BSD-3-Clause. Other integrated codecs have separate terms and are not cleared by this entry.
conditions: Select only the reviewed modules explicitly; never run the all-codec preset.
Use results only as codec context, not application or GPU archive timings.
Do not redistribute the binary or reuse its code without a separate compliance review.

PeaZip.basis: Official project terms explicitly permit free personal, professional and commercial use of its official LGPL-3.0 packages. Application measurements are separate from backend-only timings.
conditions: Use an unmodified official package with its original component notices.
Measure ZIP/7z without separately installed proprietary RAR or ACE plugins.
Do not label a backend-only command as PeaZip application performance.
Do not redistribute the package or copy its website text or artwork in a result chart.

NanaZip.basis: MIT-owned code, 7-Zip and other component licenses, and CC-BY-ND-4.0 icons. Exact package/backend scope still requires review.
conditions: Do not copy or adapt NanaZip icons.
Do not label a 7-Zip backend invocation as NanaZip application performance.

WinRAR.basis: Reviewed EULA permits licensed use but requires payment after a 40-day trial. No current license or evaluation entitlement has been verified on this host.
conditions: Excluded from the free-tool comparison plan; use 7-Zip, Bandizip Standard or PeaZip instead.
Do not bundle its executable with SuperZip or reverse engineer RAR compression.

WinZip.basis: Current Corel EULA General Terms, License Restrictions (l), restricts performing or disclosing benchmarks. No overriding agreement or written permission has been established.
conditions: Excluded from active runs and published comparisons; use an eligible comparator instead.

Silesia.basis: Author page offers a compression corpus but does not establish a blanket license for its mixed source/document/medical-image components. Historical numeric records are retained for audit, not silently relicensed.
conditions: Excluded from new runs and headline comparisons; use a separately licensed replacement instead.
Never commit corpus payloads or assume medical-image redistribution rights.

HouseholdPower.basis: UCI explicitly licenses the empirical household-power dataset under CC-BY-4.0. This is one numeric time-series workload, not a representative mixed-file corpus. Redistribution hold is repository policy, not a restriction in the dataset license.
conditions: Attribute Georges Hebrail and Alice Berard (2006), Individual Household Electric Power Consumption, UCI, DOI 10.24432/C58K54 and CC-BY-4.0.
Record exact source hashes, byte windows and complete-row trimming; preserve missing values and line endings without padding, cycling or generated substitution.
Do not commit or ship dataset payloads. Publish original numerical measurements with attribution and selection limits; do not imply UCI or creator endorsement.

Canterbury.basis: University of Canterbury explicitly supplies this fixed eleven-file corpus for lossless compression evaluation. This admits local benchmarking and original measurements; it does not establish a blanket copyright license for embedded works or program code.
conditions: Use the original fixed natural corpus with exact bytes and published file lengths; reject mirrors with normalized line endings.
Attribute Arnold and Bell (1997), A corpus for the evaluation of lossless compression algorithms, DCC 1997.
Keep payloads in RAM; do not execute constituents, copy embedded source into the product or commit/redistribute corpus files.
Publish original numerical measurements and disclose corpus age and limited coverage; do not imply university endorsement.

Pythia14M.basis: EleutherAI explicitly applies Apache-2.0 to Pythia code, models and copyrightable artifacts. Review on 2026-10-06 admits local inert-byte compression of this complete immutable trained checkpoint and original measurements; the catalog's existing expiry remains unchanged.
conditions: Attribute EleutherAI, Pythia, and Apache-2.0. Use only the pinned complete model.safetensors artifact and authenticate its exact publisher LFS digest before benchmarking.
Treat the complete checkpoint as inert RAM bytes. Never load a model, deserialize pickle, execute training code, extract selected tensors or write corpus payloads to disk.
Admit bounded HTTPS redirects only inside the reviewed huggingface.co and hf.co publisher domains; retain complete artifact hashing and reject changed identity.

Publish original numerical measurements with this single small model's coverage limitation; do not imply general AI-model effectiveness or upstream endorsement. Payload redistribution remains on hold as repository policy.

Govdocs1Thread0.basis: Digital Corpora explicitly releases Govdocs1 for research and supplies standardized pilot-study threads. Its CC0 terms exclude materials claiming separate copyrights; local inert-byte compression measurements do not establish redistribution rights for every constituent.
conditions: Use the entire current published thread0 inventory; preserve natural file bytes and report the actual current count rather than the historical nominal 1000.
Attribute Garfinkel, Farrell, Roussev and Dinolt (2009), Bringing Science to Digital Forensics with Standardized Forensic Corpora, DFRWS 2009.
The publisher warns that some corpus files contain malware. Treat members exclusively as inert RAM byte sequences; never execute, render, extract to disk or disable antivirus protections.
Record source object identity and full archive/member SHA-256 fingerprints; never call a multipart ETag a cryptographic checksum.
Do not commit or ship corpus payloads. This is a broad forensic-file workload, not a universal compression ranking or a current AI-model dataset.

HIGGS.basis: UCI explicitly licenses the dataset under CC-BY-4.0. Suitable as a large numeric-table candidate, not a representative mixed-file corpus.
conditions: Attribute Daniel Whiteson, HIGGS (2014), UCI, DOI 10.24432/C5V312, and CC-BY-4.0.
Document every split, transformation, byte count and hash.
Do not distribute the dataset through this repository; retrieve from UCI.
